**Tabel 1** is a central structured overview within the Danish national guidelines for atrial fibrillation ("Atrieflimren i Danmark"), detailing the recommended content elements for patient education. It functions as a primary operational reference for healthcare professionals and serves as a baseline for clinical quality measurements across Denmark. 

As part of the evidence-based quality standards published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, the table establishes the core informational requirements for [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]] (patient education) [^src1]. Specifically, the [[afdk-anbefaler|AFDK anbefaler]] (AFDK recommendations) mandate that the educational content outlined in Tabel 1 must be actively adapted to the individual patient's specific clinical situation [^src1]. Furthermore, the guidelines dictate that the delivery of this information should be tailored to the format of the education being conducted, whether it is administered on an individual basis or in a group setting [^src1]. 

By standardizing these educational components, Tabel 1 ensures that patients with atrial fibrillation receive consistent, comprehensive, and personalized information to support their clinical follow-up and disease management.
